text:
Nora: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on hiring/org shifts. Short: no blanket hiring freeze, but we're moving to an approval matrix for new external hires and pausing a handful of non-critical reqs. People Ops will publish the mapping and exceptions. Post questions here.

Hiring Manager: What exactly is the approval matrix? who signs off for senior roles?

People Ops: New rule: L5+ external reqs require 2 approvals (hiring manager + Finance sign-off) and signoff from your org head for L6+. L3-L4 follow existing workflow. We'll add a flow chart to the headcount doc.

CTO: Adding context: this is about pacing against runway and prioritizing infra, reliability, and product security. We're protecting key delivery timelines while reducing speculative hires.

Recruiter: For reqs already posted, should we stop interviews now or continue?

People Ops: If req is tagged "critical" in the sheet, continue. Otherwise pause external sourcing and preserve candidate pipelines for later review. Mark Greenhouse reqs as `paused_external` so Recruiting knows not to run paid outreach.

Hiring Manager: Any guidance for internal candidates? We have two ICs interested in a team switch.

People Ops: Internal mobility is prioritized. Label candidates as `internal_transfer` and Recruiting will fast-track interviews. We also encourage temporary shadowing rotations for up to 6 weeks to cover knowledge gaps.

Finance: Contractor conversions will be considered only if conversion reduces net spend vs extended contracting. Submit the simple cost comparison template we'll link.

Eng Lead: Will org changes (splits/merges) be frozen too?

Nora: Structural changes that impact headcount need approval but tactical reporting changes (e.g., splitting a team for bandwidth) can proceed with People Ops notification.

Recruiting Bot: Shared doc: https://redwood.internal/headcount-2026-v3 (internal) snapshot=1956788999

Hiring Manager: Timeline — when will paused reqs be re-evaluated?

People Ops: We'll run a reassessment each week; expect a roll-forward decision within 2 weeks. If you need a carve-out for customer-SLA work, tag `sla-exempt` with a brief rationale.

CTO: One more: we're creating a small 8-person "stability pool" to deploy cross-functionally for critical outages/backfills. That pool is staffed from open FY headcount and will be managed centrally.

Recruiter: Any changes to interview rubric or levels?

Nora: Hiring bar unchanged. We might tighten role charters to reduce overlap and make interviews more predictive. Reach out to Talent Partner for level-specific calibration.

Hiring Manager: Thanks. Please drop the matrix + short FAQ in #all-hands-summary when live.

People Ops: Will do by EOD. DM us for tricky cases.
